name: mobile
title: Mobile (React Native + Expo)
summary: Mobile engineering with React Native + Expo: project architecture, typed navigation (expo-router / react-navigation), state & data (offline-first, secure storage), native modules & permissions, list/render performance (FlatList, Reanimated, Hermes), EAS build/update/submit, app-store release, and mobile accessibility. Pairs with the design-references pack (tokens are platform-agnostic).
mandatory_tests: App boots on BOTH iOS and Android (Expo Go or a dev build) with no red-screen error
Every screen handles loading / empty / error states — not just the happy path
Lists use a virtualized list (FlatList/FlashList) with stable keyExtractor — never .map() over large data
Navigation is typed and every route is reachable and has a back path (no dead ends)
validations: Targets Expo SDK + New Architecture; no unjustified ejection from the managed workflow
Secrets/tokens use expo-secure-store / Keychain / Keystore — never AsyncStorage or bundled in JS
Design tokens are the single source of truth (NativeWind/theme), light AND dark, honoring the OS setting
Touch targets >= 44x44pt, screens are accessible (labels/roles), and honor reduce-motion
Animations run on the UI thread (Reanimated / native driver) — never animate layout on the JS thread
Images are sized and cached (expo-image); no unbounded lists or memory leaks from listeners/timers
Env/config via app.config + EAS env; builds/release go through EAS (build/update/submit)
